title: Fantasy Foosball Year 8, 2026: Week 2 Preview
subtitle: With six playoff spots available, early-season modeled chances remain volatile as six matchups put records and playoff paths in motion.

playoffModel.description: Seeded Monte Carlo estimate using current record, scoring strength and remaining Sleeper schedule.

teamA.leagueLore: Two-time champion (2020, 2021). Rivals: Parker, Andy, CJ, Alex.

matchups.headline: Payton’s Former Champions Face Evan’s Early Juggernaut
matchups.paragraph: Payton’s I ♥️ Big Tet-Tees enters Week 2 ranked 10th at 0-1, while Evan’s Bonnie Blue 42 sits first at 1-0. The model gives Payton a 6.4% playoff chance, rising to 13% with a win and falling to 5.1% with a loss—a 7.9-point swing. Evan’s already formidable chance is 99.2%, moving only to 99.4% with victory or 98% with defeat. The early-season volatility matters far more for the two-time champion than for the 2023 champion.

matchups.headline: A Rivalry With Real Room to Move
matchups.paragraph: Andy and Alex both begin 1-0, but Alex’s I love big TD’s ranks fourth versus Andy’s Long dong silvers in sixth. Alex carries the stronger modeled playoff chance at 87.2%, with a win lifting it to 92.1% and a loss lowering it to 80.6%. Andy’s 68.4% chance shifts more sharply: 79.4% after a win or 60.2% after a loss, a 19.2-point swing. Their supplied lore lists each as the other’s rival, adding context to a meaningful early test.

matchups.headline: Top-Three Collision, Modest Model Movement
matchups.paragraph: Kane’s Blueballs and CJ’s cjbroadway23 meet with both managers 1-0 and ranked second and third, respectively. Kane holds a 97.7% modeled playoff chance, compared with 97% for CJ. A Kane win moves that estimate to 98.9%, while a loss drops it to 96.4%, a 2.5-point swing. CJ’s chance reaches 98.8% with victory and falls to 95.4% with defeat, a 3.4-point swing. With six playoff spots, the model sees strong positions and limited immediate movement.

matchups.headline: Kade and Kohlt Put Playoff Paths Under Pressure
matchups.paragraph: Kade’s CheesusJesus is fifth at 1-0, while Kohlt’s kohlt is eighth at 0-1. The model gives Kade a 74.5% playoff chance, rising to 81.6% with a win and falling to 63% with a loss, an 18.6-point swing. Kohlt’s 16.5% chance improves to 25.4% after victory but declines to 11% after defeat, a 14.4-point swing. Their supplied lore names Kane as a rival for both managers, framing a matchup with substantial early-season consequences.

teamA.leagueLore: 2019 inaugural champion. League Public Enemy. Nickname: King of Dogshit Trades. Rivals: everyone.

matchups.headline: Winless Managers Seek a Needed Lift
matchups.paragraph: Parker and Joey both enter 0-1, ranked 11th and 12th, respectively. Parker’s My BallDak hurts has a 7.4% modeled playoff chance, which rises to 11% with a win and falls to 3.6% with a loss. Joey’s Off Constantly starts at 4.4%, moving to 6.9% after victory or 2% after defeat. Parker’s supplied lore calls him the league’s Public Enemy and says his rivals are everyone; Joey’s lore identifies Andy and Evan as rivals. Early odds remain volatile.

matchups.headline: A Battle to Climb From 0-1
matchups.paragraph: Cooper’s Jack MeHoff and Brae’s Ogles Outlaws are both 0-1, with Brae ranked seventh and Cooper ninth. The model gives Cooper an 11.2% playoff chance, rising to 16.2% with a win and dropping to 7.2% with a loss, a 9-point swing. Brae starts at 30.1%, reaches 38.3% with victory, and falls to 19.9% with defeat, an 18.4-point swing. Their supplied lore names Kade as Cooper’s rival and Parker and Andy as Brae’s.
